title: Cardinal Billing Account New-Driver Deposit on the Renewal Down Payment: Questions Answered
content:
**Rule.** A new-driver deposit is added to the renewal down payment of a Cardinal Billing Account after the down payment has been bounded by the pay plan's minimum down payment and the renewal full-term premium: **$75.00** when a driver was added to the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy with an effective date less than 3 whole months before the bill date, **$40.00** when no driver but a vehicle was added with an effective date in that window, and none otherwise; the sum is the renewal down payment, rounded to the cent.

## Questions answered

**Which records decide the deposit?**
The driver-add and vehicle-add transactions on the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy's transaction history, by their effective dates, counted back from the bill date (the renewal bill date).

**What is the window?**
Effective dates less than 3 whole months before the bill date, counted on calendar months.

**A driver and a vehicle were both added in the window. Which deposit applies?**
$75.00. The $40.00 deposit applies only when no driver was added in the window.

**Two drivers were added in the window. Is the deposit doubled?**
No. The deposit is $75.00 when a driver was added; the number of drivers added does not change it.

**Does the deposit move the down payment above the renewal full-term premium?**
It can. The deposit is added after the bound and the bound is not applied again, so the renewal down payment may come out above the renewal full-term premium.

| Driver added in the window | Vehicle added in the window | Deposit |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes or No | $75.00 |
| No | Yes | $40.00 |
| No | No | None |

**Hypothetical figure.** A bounded down payment of $248.30 with a vehicle (and no driver) added 1 month before the bill date: $248.30 plus $40.00, a renewal down payment of $288.30.
